title.purpose: Page headings and section headings. Top of hierarchy on every screen.

body.purpose: All prose, metadata, field values. Max 65ch on reading surfaces.

label.purpose: Form labels, column headers, category section headings. Uppercase tracked — structural divider.

caption.purpose: Supporting metadata — stock counts, secondary data. Quiet Ash color.

shadows.name: flat
shadows.purpose: All cards and containers at rest. Tonal contrast from Parchment on Canvas is sufficient.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Clickable cards on hover. Warm-tinted, soft, directional.

shadows.name: elevated
shadows.purpose: Open dropdowns, active popovers. Slightly stronger; same warm family.

motion.name: standard
motion.purpose: Default transition for color, border, opacity, and box-shadow state changes.

motion.name: lift
motion.purpose: Hover lift on interactive cards and buttons (translateY(-1px) or translateY(-4px)).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action trigger. Sage Moss fill. Used once per form or screen section.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(72% 0.09 155); color: oklch(99% 0.004 95); padding: 10px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(65% 0.11 155); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(72% 0.09 155); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral action. Warm Chalk fill. Used for Cancel and supporting actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: oklch(87% 0.010 95); color: oklch(22% 0.008 95); padding: 10px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(82% 0.012 95); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(72% 0.09 155); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action. Muted Clay fill. Calm, not alarming.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: oklch(60% 0.16 25); color: oklch(99% 0.004 95); padding: 10px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: oklch(54% 0.18 25); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(60% 0.16 25); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Clickable inventory item tile. Flat at rest, lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-product-card { background: oklch(99% 0.004 95); border: 1px solid oklch(87% 0.010 95); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px; box-shadow: none; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; display: flex; flex-direction: column; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-product-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px oklch(22% 0.008 95 / 0.10); border-color: oklch(82% 0.012 95); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-product-card__name { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(22% 0.008 95); } .ds-product-card p { margin: 4px 0; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(22% 0.008 95); }

components.name: Category Card
components.description: Clickable category tile in the category list.
components.html:
Stationery

Notebooks, pens, and desk accessories.
components.css: .ds-category-card { background: oklch(99% 0.004 95); border: 1px solid oklch(87% 0.010 95); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px; box-shadow: none; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-category-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px oklch(22% 0.008 95 / 0.10); border-color: oklch(82% 0.012 95); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-category-card__title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(22% 0.008 95); } .ds-category-card__desc { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(57% 0.010 95); font-style: italic; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field with uppercase label above. Focus shifts border to Sage Moss.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-field__label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(57% 0.010 95); } .ds-input { border: 1px solid oklch(87% 0.010 95); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(22% 0.008 95); background: oklch(99% 0.004 95); outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease; font-family: inherit; } .ds-input:focus { border: 2px solid oklch(72% 0.09 155); padding: 7px 11px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(57% 0.010 95); } .ds-input:disabled { background: oklch(96% 0.008 95); color: oklch(57% 0.010 95); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: Dark anchoring header. The only Warm Ink surface in the interface.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-navbar { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: oklch(22% 0.008 95); color: oklch(99% 0.004 95); padding: 15px 30px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-navbar__logo { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(99% 0.004 95); } .ds-navbar__links { display: flex; gap: 20px; } .ds-navbar__link { color: oklch(99% 0.004 95); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; transition: opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-navbar__link:hover { opacity: 0.85; text-decoration: underline; }

components.name: Category Section Header
components.description: Pale Sage strip with uppercase label. Divides grouped product sections without extra borders.
components.css: .ds-section-header { background: oklch(94% 0.015 155); border-bottom: 2px solid oklch(87% 0.010 95); padding: 8px 20px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-section-header__title { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(22% 0.008 95); }

narrative.overview:
A ledger is not decorative. It is precise, structured, and quietly confident — every entry in its place, every column legible at a glance. This interface carries that character: pastel surfaces that organize without competing, typography that delivers information without ceremony, and space used with intention. Nothing here is accidental.

The palette is warm and soft — sage greens, warm whites, quiet ash — but never precious. Color is working structure: it marks section boundaries, signals interaction, and guides the eye from section to action. The goal is that a reviewer pauses and sees considered decisions, not assembled defaults.

This system rejects the generic purple-gradient SaaS aesthetic entirely. No dark-mode-by-default, no glowing cards, no gradient-filled buttons, no glassmorphism, no decorative blurs. Calm and efficient — the interface earns attention by staying out of the way.
keyCharacteristics: Single pastel sage accent on a warm off-white ground
Generous whitespace; sections breathe before they stack
Uppercase tracked labels as structural dividers — no extra borders needed
Flat cards at rest; elevation earned only through hover state
Every neutral carries a fractional warm tint — the warmth is invisible as a fact and perceptible as a feeling

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Sage Moss appears on one interaction type per screen at a time. Pale Sage handles ambient hierarchy. Sage Moss marks action.

rules.name: The Warm Tint Rule
rules.body: Every neutral carries a fractional warm tint (hue 95, chroma 0.004–0.012). Pure white and pure black are prohibited.

rules.name: The Label-as-Divider Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels (13px, 600, 0.04em) replace visual separators. Before adding a rule or border, ask whether a label can carry the structural weight instead.

rules.name: The Earned Elevation Rule
rules.body: Shadows are a response to state, not a badge of importance. A static, non-interactive surface has no shadow.

dos: Do use Sage Moss as the only saturated accent. One color carries action — its restraint is the point.
Do tint every neutral toward hue 95, chroma 0.004–0.012. Pure white and pure black are banned.
Do use uppercase tracked labels (13px, 600, 0.04em) as structural dividers before reaching for borders.
Do keep all cards flat at rest. Shadows appear on hover only.
Do use Pale Sage tints for ambient hierarchy before using shadows or borders.
Do keep layouts open: one PageShell at max-width 1200px with consistent lg (20px) padding.
Do use transform and opacity for all animation. Never animate layout properties.
donts: Don't use purple, violet, indigo, or any blue-shifted hue as an accent. The purple-gradient SaaS aesthetic is explicitly banned.
Don't use gradient backgrounds, gradient-filled buttons, or background-clip text gradients.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards or list items.
Don't default to dark mode. Warm Ink is used only for the Navbar.
Don't install additional CSS libraries, component frameworks, or icon packages.
Don't add emoji, decorative icons, or illustrative elements.
Don't apply a shadow to a non-interactive surface.
Don't use Bootstrap density — tight gutters, small form elements, crowded grids.
